escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, the start line of a technology race inside a dark hangar-like studio at night): she (the woman of the references, her face exactly as in the references) stands UPRIGHT at the start line in a confident athletic ready stance, one foot slightly forward, fists loose, shoulders squared to camera, framed from the waist up on the RIGHT half of the frame, a heroic medium shot. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: the camera is about two meters away at chest height with an 85mm lens, so nothing is foreshortened and she does not lean toward the lens; her head is in natural proportion to her athletic body, the head occupies about one quarter of the frame height, her shoulders are clearly wider than two head-widths, the torso and arms read full and strong. She wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate on her left side exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering), the bionic glasses exactly as in their reference, and she has no watch, no bracelet and no ring; her eyes are clearly visible through the transparent lenses, no mirror reflection covers her eyes. She looks straight into the lens with a fearless, confident half-smile, razor-thin focus on her eyes behind the lenses. Behind her, far and out of focus, a row of five round azure start lights hangs in the haze, all lit. Around her, a squad of FIVE Sparks, copied EXACTLY from their two references, all clearly ready to race with her: one sits on her shoulder pumping a tiny fist, sharp; one hovers low over a ledge in the soft foreground, close to the lens, leaning forward as if ready to launch; behind her, at unequal heights and distances, EXACTLY THREE more Sparks (FIVE in total, never more), the same figures as the Spark references, smaller in frame and out of focus, their LED eyes reading as glowing dots: one leans forward ready to launch, one gives a thumbs-up, one is caught mid-leap with excitement; the Sparks stay small, never larger than her head. Their LED eyes, the start lights and her suit seams are the only blue light sources; a hard key light from the left sculpts her face; volumetric haze and a cool rim light behind; anamorphic flares kept subtle. The LEFT half of the frame is calm, dark, empty studio space with soft haze and no objects. No readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the dark blurred edge of the starting ledge close to the lens

texto.muro: the calm, dark, empty studio space on the left half
